summary: The note describes Titian's painting The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence, completed in 1558 and now housed in the church of I Gesuiti in Venice. Its strong impact on Philip II of Spain led him to commission a second version in 1567 for the basilica at El Escorial.
one_line: Titian's 1558 painting The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence and the 1567 second version commissioned by Philip II for El Escorial.
key_facts: The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence is a 1558 painting by Titian.
The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence is now in the church of I Gesuiti in Venice.
Philip II of Spain was so impressed by the painting that he commissioned a second version.
Philip II commissioned the second version of The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence in 1567.
The second version of The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence was made for the basilica at El Escorial.
